summary: Verified offline network error toast fix in Auth (login + signup). Both flows now display the Arabic friendly message 'عذراً، لا يوجد اتصال بالإنترنت. يرجى التحقق من الشبكة وإعادة المحاولة 🔌' instead of the English 'Network Error'. Regressions for online login (valid + wrong password) and onboarding Skip all pass.

TEST_1_offline_login.toast_text: عذراً، لا يوجد اتصال بالإنترنت. يرجى التحقق من الشبكة وإعادة المحاولة 🔌

TEST_2_offline_signup.toast_text: عذراً، لا يوجد اتصال بالإنترنت. يرجى التحقق من الشبكة وإعادة المحاولة 🔌
TEST_2_offline_signup.note: Toast appeared within ~0.5s (geolocation resolved/denied fast in headless); initial 6s wait missed it due to sonner ~4s auto-dismiss. Retest with polling confirmed toast IS shown correctly.

TEST_4_online_wrong_password.toast_text: رقم الهاتف أو كلمة المرور غير صحيحة

critical_code_review_comments: errors.js isNetworkError() correctly covers navigator.onLine, ERR_NETWORK, ECONNABORTED, 'Network Error' string, and no-response cases — comprehensive.
The ASCII-only guard in errMsg (line 25) is a nice safety net to prevent English SDK strings from leaking to Arabic UI.

Minor: Auth.jsx geolocation Promise has a subtle bug — setTimeout(res, 4000) resolves the outer Promise but the getCurrentPosition callbacks continue firing later; not a correctness issue but worth cleaning up (double-resolve is a no-op for Promises).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL redirects to /onboarding on fresh state; always click data-testid=onboarding-skip before Auth tests. Sonner toasts appear as [data-sonner-toast] with rich colors, default ~4s auto-dismiss — poll frequently after action, don't wait 6s before first check. Service Worker berber-v30 does not interfere as long as offline is toggled AFTER SPA has fully hydrated.
